keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Juan Purata (Atlas).
Delay in match because of an injury Óscar Estupiñán (Juárez).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Juárez 0, Atlas 1. Víctor Ríos (Atlas) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kevin Zenón with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Juárez 1, Atlas 1. Óscar Estupiñán (Juárez) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Guilherme Castilho with a cross following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Camilo Vargas (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Juárez 1, Atlas 1.
Second Half begins Juárez 1, Atlas 1.
Madson (Juárez) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atlas. Elías Montiel replaces Víctor Ríos.
Delay in match because of an injury Ryan Mmaee (Atlas).
Delay in match because of an injury Daniel Piña (Juárez).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Florián Monzón (Atlas).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Juárez. Luca Martínez Dupuy replaces Óscar Estupiñán.
Substitution, Atlas. Jorge Sánchez replaces Aldo Rocha.
Substitution, Atlas. José Martín replaces Ryan Mmaee.
Jorge Sánchez (Atlas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Juárez 2, Atlas 1. Luca Martínez Dupuy (Juárez) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Guilherme Castilho with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Juárez. Ricardinho replaces Guilherme Castilho.
Substitution, Juárez. José Luis Rodríguez replaces Jairo Torres.
Substitution, Atlas. Sergio Hernández replaces Édgar Zaldívar.
Goal! Juárez 2, Atlas 2. Juan Purata (Atlas) header from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luís Esteves with a cross following a corner.
Gilberto Sepúlveda (Juárez) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Juárez 2, Atlas 3. Elías Montiel (Atlas) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kevin Zenón.
Goal! Juárez 3, Atlas 3. José Luis Rodríguez (Juárez) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the high centre of the goal.
Second Half ends, Juárez 3, Atlas 3.
